name: CASINO SWAZI
description: Swazi Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in Eswatini (formerly Swaziland). Features unique building mechanics where captured cards are kept face up and top cards can be stolen by opponents for builds. Uses numerical values for picture cards (J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14).

content.text: Swazi Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in Eswatini (formerly Swaziland). Features unique building mechanics where captured cards are kept face up and top cards can be stolen by opponents for builds. Uses numerical values for picture cards (J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14).

Swazi Casino is a variant of Royal Casino played in Eswatini (formerly Swaziland), a country in Southern Africa. It was documented by Jonathan Dushoff. The game is part of a family of African Casino variants that differ from Anglo-American Casino.
2-4 players. 4 players play in fixed partnerships (partners opposite). Play is anticlockwise.
Standard 52-card pack. Card values: 2-10=face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1 or 14. All picture cards have numerical values (Royal Casino style).

Player to dealer's right cuts 4 cards from middle of deck to form initial layout. Dealer deals all cards to players one at a time. First dealer random; deal passes right. If initial layout has 3+ points in scoring cards or 3+ picture cards, reshuffle and recut.
